ios.desc:
XConnect brings SSH, Telnet, SFTP and Windows Remote Desktop together in one app built for iPhone. Manage Linux servers, reach Windows machines and move files, all from your pocket.

REMOTE DESKTOP THAT WORKS ON A PHONE
XConnect includes a full RDP client, not screen mirroring. Switch between trackpad and direct touch, scroll with two fingers, pinch to zoom, right-click, and use a hardware keyboard with sticky modifier keys.

A TERMINAL MADE FOR TOUCH
• A dedicated key row puts arrows, Ctrl and other essentials above the keyboard
• Full-screen mode for long sessions
• SSH with password or key authentication, plus Telnet for legacy devices
• Jump hosts work like OpenSSH ProxyJump, so you can reach servers on private networks

AN AI ASSISTANT THAT GETS THINGS DONE
Describe the task, such as "check how much disk space is left", and the assistant plans it, runs the commands on your server, reads the real output and reports back. Before anything destructive, it stops and asks for your confirmation. Connect the AI provider of your choice.

SCRIPTS, READY TO RUN
Start with ready-made scripts for backups, disk usage, Docker, listening ports, failed services and more. View and edit them on your phone, or write your own, then run them on any connected server.

SFTP FILE MANAGEMENT
Browse remote directories, filter by files or folders, and upload or download with a tap.

LOCAL FIRST, PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your connections, groups, scripts and keys are stored encrypted on your device. No account is needed to use SSH, Telnet and SFTP. When you want your setup on more devices, turn on sync: it is end-to-end encrypted, so the server never sees your data in plain text.

XCONNECT PRO
Free: SSH, Telnet, SFTP, the script library and one jump host.
Pro unlocks:
• Remote Desktop (RDP)
• The AI assistant
• Running scripts from the terminal
• Unlimited jump hosts
• End-to-end encrypted cloud sync across your devices

XConnect Pro is available as an auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Pro is tied to your XConnect account, so sign in first to subscribe.

Terms of Use: https://xconnectapp.com/ios/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://xconnectapp.com/ios/privacy.html

show_hn.title: Show HN: I compiled FreeRDP into a Flutter app so my phone can do RDP and SSH

quotes.text:
Hi HN, I'm the developer. XConnect is an SSH/SFTP client for iOS and Android that also has a real RDP client built in, so one app covers my Linux and Windows machines when I'm away from my desk. No account needed: tap "Continue Offline" and everything stays on the phone.
I built it because fixing things from my phone meant switching between an SSH app, a file app and Microsoft's RDP app, and on a small screen the switching was the worst part.
What it does:
- SSH and Telnet, with a key row for phone keyboards (Esc, Tab, arrows, sticky Ctrl/Alt, one-tap Ctrl-C/D/L/Z) and multiple sessions.
- RDP (iOS for now). FreeRDP 3 is compiled into the app, so the phone speaks RDP directly, with no gateway or relay. Trackpad or direct-touch mode, pinch to zoom, two-finger right-click and scroll. Hardware keyboards are forwarded by scancode.
- SFTP, jump hosts (ProxyJump-style, for both SSH and SFTP), and 14 built-in scripts you can run on a server with one tap.
- An optional AI agent with your own API key (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Anthropic, or Ollama on your LAN). It runs commands on the host and asks before anything that looks destructive. It does nothing until you configure it.
Some technical details: the native RDP core sends Dart one event per frame (connected / bitmap / resize / error / disconnected), in the same binary format my desktop app's RDP helper uses.
